text:
maria: Heads-up, onboarding new-chat-7b (q4f16) revealed a weird rep_penalty regression when using HF generation_config + our chat template. Repro and config below.

sam: can you paste the exact generation_config.json you used?

maria: sure — snippet from the model repo:
```json
{
  "temperature": 0.0,
  "top_p": 0.95,
  "top_k": 40,
  "repetition_penalty": 1.15
}
```
I pushed it as-is. HF-style file. When we convert to Redwood defaults the outputs are overly repetitive in some prompts (same token repeated), despite rep_penalty > 1.

lee: quick thought — our mapping historically sets do_sample = temperature > 0. If temperature == 0 we switch to greedy decoding (do_sample=false) which bypasses sampling-time hooks like repetition_penalty in some samplers. Could that be it?

aj: confirmed in logs for a failing run: "sampler=greedy". So rep_penalty wasn't applied because we flipped to greedy when temp==0 during conversion.

sam: that matches. HF treats temperature 0 as deterministic but repetition_penalty in their implementation can still affect logits before argmax in some configs. Our conversion ended up disabling the whole sampling pipeline. Workaround: set temperature to a tiny positive value and keep do_sample true.

maria: quick local test: prompt "Ok." with generation_config above produced repeating "Ok Ok Ok Ok" downstream. Changing temp to 1e-06 and forcing do_sample=true removes the repetition. Example reproduction below:
```text
prompt: "Ok."
config A (temp=0): "Ok Ok Ok Ok\n"
config B (temp=1e-06 + do_sample=true): "Ok.\n"
```

lee: two follow-ups:
1) we should update the HF->Redwood mapper to preserve "do_sample" semantics: if generation_config explicitly sets repetition_penalty but temp==0, set do_sample=true and temp=1e-6 when importing. Add a migration flag so we don't silently change user intent.
2) add unit tests covering chat templates with role tokens — I noticed special tokenization differences: some HF chat templates include special role tokens like "<|assistant|>" vs our normalized "__assistant__" which changes token ids and interacts with quantized vocab remapping. That exacerbates the repetition for q4f16.

aj: +1 on tests. On quantization note: q4 token remapping can make repeated short tokens become lower-entropy candidates after dequantization; combined with greedy path it's a perfect storm.

sam: I'll draft a tiny patch for the mapper and a test harness. Proposed change (pseudocode):
```python
if "repetition_penalty" in gen_cfg and gen_cfg["temperature"] == 0:
    gen_cfg["temperature"] = 1e-6
    gen_cfg["do_sample"] = True
    meta["rw_migration"] = "rep_penalty_temp_fix"
```
We should also log a warning when we coerce values so customers notice.

eval-bot: Queued eval job: "gen-config-rep-penalty-check" across models [new-chat-7b-q4f16, new-chat-7b-q8] using 50 curated prompts (chat-like, short-turn). ETA ~30m. Results will post to #eng-ml when done.

maria: thanks, team. i'll open the PR with tests + changelog note. tagging @lee for review and @aj for any infra flags. :thumbsup:
